_comment: SAMPLE CONTENT - NOT FROM NOMURA. The knowledge base PDF covers general IT faults but not identity: password reset, account lockout and expiry are callback reasons the voice agent handles, so without these the chat denies requests it is expected to answer. These steps are written from common corporate IT practice and are placeholders. Replace them with Nomura's real procedures before anyone relies on them - especially the portal names, lockout timings and password policy. Edit this file and re-run scripts/build_kb.py.

articles.title: Reset your Nomura password
steps: Open the Nomura self-service password portal and choose Forgot password.
Confirm your identity with the authenticator app or a code sent to your registered mobile number.
Choose a new password that meets policy: at least 12 characters with upper and lower case, a number and a symbol, and not one you have used before.
Sign out of Outlook, Teams and the VPN client, then sign back in with the new password so saved credentials update.
notes: The service desk will never ask you for your password or a verification code.
If you are off the network you must be connected to the VPN before the new password applies to your laptop.

escalation.when: Self-service reset fails or the portal is unavailable

articles.title: Account locked after too many failed sign-ins
steps: Wait 15 minutes. Accounts unlock on their own once the lockout period passes.
Find anything still trying the old password - a phone mail app, a mapped drive, a second laptop - and sign out there first, or it will lock the account again.
Once the lockout clears, sign in again with your current password.
If you no longer know the password, reset it through the self-service portal instead.
notes: Repeated lockouts within an hour almost always mean a device is still caching the old password.

escalation.when: Still locked out after the wait and a password reset

articles.title: Password expiring soon
steps: Change it before it expires rather than after - an expired password locks you out of Outlook and Teams until it is reset.
On the Nomura network or connected to the VPN, press Ctrl + Alt + Delete and choose Change a password.
Enter your current password, then the new one twice.
Sign out and back in so Outlook, Teams and the VPN client pick up the change.
notes: If it has already expired, use the self-service password portal to reset it instead.

escalation.when: Change a password is greyed out or rejects the new password
